extracted.intended_audience: writers seeking grants, awards, fellowships, and residencies
extracted.subtask_description: Using PEN's Grants & Awards database to identify grant, award, fellowship, and residency opportunities for writers; entries list genre, eligibility, deadlines, award amounts, and other application-relevant details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Search by keyword, genre, organization, or deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The database is designed to be queried by these fields to find opportunities matching a writer's genre, organizational source, or timing; use precise keywords and genre filters to narrow results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline (submission date)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listing includes a submission deadline; meeting the stated deadline is a fundamental eligibility requirement. Verify the specific deadline on the complete listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Genre classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Listings include genre labels such as 'Poetry' and 'Academic Writing, Nonfiction'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Opportunities are genre-specific; confirm that your work matches the listed genre(s) before applying.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award specifies both the type of work (a translation) and a citizenship eligibility requirement (U.S. citizen). Consult the full listing for complete scope (source language, publication status, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Raiziss/de Palchi Book Prize — award amount and frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: The Raiziss/de Palchi Translation Award consists of a $5,000 book prize or a $25,000 fellowship, given in alternate years, ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes both the monetary award options and that the prize/fellowship alternates by year; check which form is offered for the current cycle and any eligibility distinctions between prize vs fellowship.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award is for an outstanding book on U.S. agricultural history; eligibility likely requires publication within a certain time window—confirm specifics on the complete listing.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awarded for the best dissertation in the field (agricultural history); check the listing for dissertation date, degree requirements, and submission materials.

rubrics_metrics.description: The Wayne D. Rasmussen Award of $200, is given to the author of the best article on agricultural history pu...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award targets individual articles; verify publication venue/timeframe eligibility and submission procedure on the full listing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vernon Carstensen Award — best article in quarterly
rubrics_metrics.description: The Vernon Carstensen Award of $200, is given to the best article published by a scholar in the quarterly j...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies publication in a particular quarterly journal; consult the complete listing for journal identity and eligibility window.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency of listings
rubrics_metrics.description: Updated every month, Grants & Awards is assured to offer the most current listings online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listings are refreshed monthly; still verify deadlines and details on the source organization's site before applying, as changes can occur between updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensiveness / inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: With more than 1,500 listings of domestic and foreign grants, literary awards, fellowships, and residencies*, Grants & Awards is the most comprehensive online database available to writers of all income brackets, at work in all genres, and at various levels of achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The database aims to cover opportunities across genres, income levels, and career stages—use genre and deadline filters to find matches appropriate to your career level and financial need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access and subscription terms
rubrics_metrics.description: One-Year Subscription: $12 — One-year access to more than 1,000 listings of grants, awards, and residencies available to American writers. One-Year Subscription for PEN Members: $10. One-Year Institutional Subscription: One-year unlimited access ... $200. Associate Membership with Grants & Awards: $46 (Save 10%). Student Associate Membership with Grants & Awards: $26 (Save 20%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access to full listings requires a paid subscription or membership; institutional subscriptions provide multi-user access. Consider membership discounts (student or PEN member) when budgeting for access.
